items.title: Gulf of Mexico oil/gas shut-ins drop to ~30% as crews return
items.summary: US Gulf of Mexico producers had shut in 29.63% of current daily oil production and 24.81% of natural gas production as of 11:00 a.m. CDT Monday Oct 12, per the Marine Minerals Administration - a sharp recovery from Friday's 71.5% oil / 58.8% gas peak ahead of Isaias's landfall. Personnel remain evacuated from only 5 of 371 manned platforms and 1 of 11 fixed rigs as operators inspect facilities and restart output.

items.title: Landslide destroys house in Acapulco amid Simon's heavy rains
items.summary: Heavy rains ahead of Hurricane Simon triggered a landslide in Acapulco, Guerrero that destroyed a house, per AFP. The damage occurred as Simon's outer rainbands soaked Mexico's Pacific coast over the weekend. It is separate from the previously reported Guerrero storm death (an elderly person).
